title: Guide lines close on a dot that punches into a ring
summary: Four hairline guides slide in from the frame edges and box a gradient dot as it grows; the dot dips, a hole punches open and it swells into a ring, then the ring thins away as the guides fly back out. A 3 s loopable mark sting.
use_when: A short loopable sting for a round or ring-shaped mark
A light, design-tool or precision-themed brand that wants a construction-grid feel
A bumper before or after a longer film, no copy needed
A gradient brand colour that should carry the moment on white

sfx.event: dot appears at the centre and grows
hole punches open and the disc swells into a ring
ring thins away and the guides fly out

structure.shot: white frame with 4 grey hairline guides on its edges; a vertical-gradient dot appears at centre and grows to a disc 31 % of H
structure.camera: locked frame; the scale change motion.json reads as zoom is the dot and guides themselves
structure.motion: guides slide from the frame edges f2 to a box 2 px outside the disc by f25, easings.inOutCubic 23 fr; dot visible f6 (8 px), grows to 222 px @720 by f25, easings.inOutCubic 19 fr, no overshoot; hold f25-f35

structure.shot: the disc dips, a white hole punches open at its centre and the disc swells into a thick gradient ring 50 % of H; guides track its box
structure.camera: locked frame; guides re-box the ring, box 226 -> 362 px @720
structure.motion: anticipation: disc 222 -> 206 px (-7 %) f35-f42, easings.inOutSine 7 fr; hole opens at f41 (9 px) -> 210 px by f58; outer 206 -> 358 px f42-f61, easings.outCubic 19 fr, no overshoot at 30 fps; inner/outer = 0.59; hold f61-f76

structure.shot: the ring's band thins inward to a hairline and vanishes; the guides fly back to the frame edges, ending on the empty first frame
structure.camera: locked frame; guides box 366 px -> full frame
structure.motion: outer edge 357 -> 238 px f76-f82 while the hole holds 210 px, easings.inExpo 7 fr, gone at f83; guides out f76-f89, easings.inOutCubic 13 fr; f89 matches f0 for a seamless loop

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the frame, muted for the guides, accent stops for the ring gradient
params.gradient: 3-7 vertical stops for the dot and ring fill (default dark red, red, orange, yellow, teal, blue, navy)
params.ringRatio: inner / outer diameter of the final ring (default 0.59)
params.discSize: disc diameter as a share of H (default 0.31); ring outer = 1.61 x disc
params.guideMargin: gap between guides and the shape box (default 2 px at 720p)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; the shape stays centred, sized from H
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured per frame at 30 fps from the source: dot 8 px f6 -> 222 px f25 (720p); guides start on the frame edges and keep a ~2 px margin to the shape box; anticipation dip 7 % f35-f42 before the hole opens at f41; ring 358 px outer / 210 px inner settles f61 with no overshoot; exit thins the band from outside in (outer shrinks, hole fixed) f76-f83; guides out f76-f89; first and last frames are the same empty grid, so it loops. Gradient is vertical, dark maroon top -> red -> orange -> yellow -> teal -> navy bottom, with fine grain. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in the vocabulary): guide-box, hole-punch, band-collapse, gradient-fill.
